Slicked-back platinum white hair with a sharp, precise widow's peak. Piercing, narrow almond-shaped eyes of a vivid crimson shade. Apparent age of middle-age with a stern, regal maturity. A tall, imposing build wearing a high-collared royal purple cape with a deep red lining over a black Victorian formal suit.
SIGNATURE DETAILS: long, pointed canine fangs and pale, porcelain skin.
